notes: SPEC A8 — LLM-judgment layer for board-pack-assembler (routing + behavior). Gate 15 executor/grader; run_all.py ignores this file.

prompts.name: route_build_pack
prompts.input: build the board pack for June

prompts.name: negative_board_update_memo
assert: Does NOT fire board-pack-assembler — routes to memo-writer (memo_type=board_update, freeform)

prompts.name: negative_operator_report
assert: Does NOT fire board-pack-assembler — routes to operator-report (CEO-self-facing)

prompts.name: behavior_qbo_when_present
assert: Reads the QuickBooks MCP for financials when the connector is present

prompts.name: behavior_no_fabrication
assert: Does NOT fabricate financials when QuickBooks is absent — marks them unavailable

prompts.name: behavior_counts_event
assert: Logs a board_pack_assembled event whose section_counts match the period aggregation
